Frequency once per day
Requirements Your spirit weapon is in its released form and you have at least 1 Reiatsu Point

Bankai · Segunda Etapa · Vollständig.

For 1 minute:

  • Your spirit weapon's damage die increases by one step.
  • You gain your Spirit's Full Release ability.
  • Your Release Technique costs no Reiatsu Points, but you can use it only once per round.
  • You emit a 15-foot emanation of crushing spiritual pressure. An enemy that ends its turn in the emanation must succeed at a Will save against your Reiatsu DC or become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

When it ends you become fatigued until you rest for 10 minutes, and you can't use Full Release again today.
